Mail Ballot Drop Boxes

  • ATTENTION: For special elections voters may utilize the drop box for their specific town or the boxes at the Board of Elections and Secretary of State's office. In addition, the Board voted to allow drop boxes in every polling location. Voters may place the completed oath envelope with the enclosed voted ballot in the drop box of his/her choosing.
